mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.session_id, m.sender_id, m.sender_type, m.receiver_id, m.receiver_type, m.content, m.msg_type, m.is_read, m.create_time, COALESCE(pu.nickname, su.nick_name) AS sender_nickname, COALESCE(pu.avatar, su.avatar) AS sender_avatar FROM portal_message m LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = m.sender_id AND m.sender_type = 'portal' LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = m.sender_id AND m.sender_type = 'sys' WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY m.id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN user_a = #{userId} AND user_a_type = #{userType} THEN unread_a WHEN user_b = #{userId} AND user_b_type = #{userType} THEN unread_b ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM portal_message_session WHERE (user_a = #{userId} AND user_a_type = #{userType}) OR (user_b = #{userId} AND user_b_type = #{userType})
